titulo.alumno: A shared solution · Two short opinions

intro: Part 3: a shared solution. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: An opinion can be recognised by «jeg synes» or «efter min mening». Look for the reason that goes with it, and check whether the second text agrees, qualifies or disagrees.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
